title: Redshift: widen sensitive columns in atomic.events to support pseudonymization
body: Although we are only initially supporting SHA256 for hashing (see #3472), we will bump these columns to 512 width as this is a relatively painful process (and we will likely want to support SHA512 hashing and also encryption options later on).
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
